notes: P4B effect-functional hydrate; identity-link treatment-coef bridge. mapped_mean_tol widened from 0.35: since 36a14c46 (convert absolute prior SD^2 to conjugate V0 scale) the injected coefficient prior's tightness is expressed in the TARGET model's sigma^2 units via the SOURCE's residual-variance posterior mean, so a source (near-zero residual, deterministic DGP) transferred onto a target whose true slope disagrees inflates the target's fitted residual variance (~0.28 vs source's ~0.0006) and correspondingly loosens the shrinkage toward the source mean. On this fixture (seed 1, n=80) the corrected math lands the mapped mean at ~1.235 (0.76 from the source mean of ~2.0, still well closer to source than the 0.50 baseline is), a legitimate consequence of the V0 fix rather than a regression; mapped_closer_than_baseline still asserts the qualitative pull toward source.
